title: Find the Closest Number to the Average
description: Write the function definition for findClosestToAverage that calculates the average of an array of 5 integers and finds the number closest to the average.
hints: 1: Calculate the average by summing the numbers and dividing by the number of elements (5).
2: Use the absolute difference to determine which number is closest to the average.
3: Iterate through the array and track the smallest difference along with the corresponding number.
4: Be cautious of integer division when calculating the average; consider using a float or double.
5: Handle edge cases, such as when two numbers are equidistant from the average.
